```{r prespecification}
# ============================================================
# WRITTEN BEFORE KNITTING. Save, commit to GitHub, THEN knit.
#
# Replication criterion for the balance score (GCH1 minus SLC40A1),
# taken unchanged from the two-cohort analysis:
#   1. primary adjustment (proliferation module + ESTIMATE):
#      delta > 0, BH-FDR < 0.05 and delta >= 0.147
#   2. matched on the PAM50 proliferation module:
#      delta > 0 and |delta| above the 95th percentile of 1,000
#      random gene pairs scored in the same matched tumours
# GCH1 and SLC40A1 alone are reported beside it, not judged.
# ============================================================
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (p in c("UCSCXenaTools", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "readr", "purrr",
            "matrixStats", "pROC", "tidyestimate", "here", "data.table")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p, repos = "https://cran.r-project.org")
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(UCSCXenaTools); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble)
  library(readr); library(purrr); library(matrixStats); library(pROC)
})

root  <- here::here()
paths <- list(raw     = file.path(root, "TCGA/01_raw"),
              tables  = file.path(root, "TCGA/03_results/tables"))
invisible(lapply(paths, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))

SPEC  <- list(seed = 123, fdr = 0.05, min_delta = 0.147)
MATCH <- list(caliper = 0.2, n_null = 1000, trim_lo = 0.05, trim_hi = 0.95)
set.seed(SPEC$seed)

PAM50_PROLIF_GENES <- c("BIRC5","CCNB1","CDC20","CDC6","CENPF","CEP55","EXO1","KIF2C","MELK",
                        "MKI67","MYBL2","NDC80","NUF2","ORC6","PTTG1","RRM2","TYMS","UBE2C","UBE2T")
NONPAM50_PROLIF <- c("PCNA","MCM2","MCM3","MCM4","MCM5","MCM6","MCM7","CDK1","CCNA2","CCNB2",
                     "TOP2A","AURKA","AURKB","PLK1","BUB1","BUB1B","TTK","CDC25A","E2F1","FEN1",
                     "RFC4","GINS1","GINS2","KIF11","KIF23","RACGAP1","ASPM","DLGAP5","TPX2","PRC1")
ADJ_LEVELS <- list("Raw" = character(0), "MKI67" = "mki67",
                   "Proliferation module" = "prolif_module",
                   "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = c("prolif_module", "estimate_score"))
FEATURES <- c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1")
```

```{r helpers}
# Copied unchanged from 03_analysis_lean.Rmd
make_gene_z <- function(em) {
  rsd <- matrixStats::rowSds(em, na.rm = TRUE)
  rsd[!is.finite(rsd) | rsd == 0] <- NA_real_
  ez <- (em - rowMeans(em, na.rm = TRUE)) / rsd
  ez[!is.finite(ez)] <- NA_real_
  ez
}
residualize <- function(y, covs) {
  d <- data.frame(y = y, covs, check.names = FALSE)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(d)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(y))
  if (sum(ok) < 50) return(out)
  fit <- stats::lm(y ~ ., data = d[ok, , drop = FALSE])
  out[ok] <- d$y[ok] - stats::predict(fit, newdata = d[ok, , drop = FALSE])
  out
}
group_test <- function(y, grp) {
  a <- y[grp == "LumA" & is.finite(y)]; b <- y[grp == "LumB" & is.finite(y)]
  if (length(a) < 10 || length(b) < 10)
    return(tibble(n_LumA = length(a), n_LumB = length(b), delta = NA_real_,
                  delta_lo = NA_real_, delta_hi = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  r  <- pROC::roc(controls = a, cases = b, direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r, method = "delong"))
  tibble(n_LumA = length(a), n_LumB = length(b),
         delta = 2 * ci[2] - 1, delta_lo = 2 * ci[1] - 1, delta_hi = 2 * ci[3] - 1,
         p_value = stats::wilcox.test(b, a, exact = FALSE)$p.value)
}
fast_delta <- function(a, b) {
  a <- a[is.finite(a)]; b <- b[is.finite(b)]
  if (length(a) < 10 || length(b) < 10) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(c(a, b))
  2 * ((sum(r[(length(a) + 1):(length(a) + length(b))]) -
          length(b) * (length(b) + 1) / 2) / (length(a) * length(b))) - 1
}
smd <- function(x, g) {
  a <- x[g == "LumA"]; b <- x[g == "LumB"]
  (mean(b, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(a, na.rm = TRUE)) / sqrt((var(a, na.rm = TRUE) + var(b, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2)
}
match_11 <- function(score, grp, caliper) {
  cal <- caliper * sd(score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ia <- which(grp == "LumA"); ib <- which(grp == "LumB")
  used <- rep(FALSE, length(ia)); ka <- integer(0); kb <- integer(0)
  for (j in ib[order(score[ib])]) {
    d <- abs(score[ia] - score[j]); d[used] <- Inf
    k <- which.min(d)
    if (length(k) && is.finite(d[k]) && d[k] <= cal) { used[k] <- TRUE; ka <- c(ka, ia[k]); kb <- c(kb, j) }
  }
  sort(c(ka, kb))
}
```

## 1. Expression and PAM50 calls

TCGA-BRCA Illumina HiSeq RNA-seq, log2(RSEM normalised count + 1), from the
UCSC Xena TCGA hub. PAM50 calls are the `PAM50Call_RNAseq` field distributed
with the clinical matrix, taken as supplied and not recomputed, as in the
other two cohorts.

```{r download, message=FALSE}
options(timeout = 3600)   # R's default of 60 s cuts the 61 MB matrix short

# Downloads once, checks the file is complete, and reuses it on later knits.
# A truncated file from a failed attempt is deleted and fetched again.
get_xena <- function(pattern) {
  q <- XenaGenerate(subset = XenaHostNames == "tcgaHub") %>%
    XenaFilter(filterDatasets = pattern) %>% XenaQuery()
  f <- file.path(paths$raw, basename(q$url))
  ok_gz <- function(f) file.exists(f) && (!grepl("\\.gz$", f) ||
    !inherits(try(readLines(gzfile(f), n = 1e6, warn = FALSE), silent = TRUE), "try-error"))
  if (!ok_gz(f)) {
    if (file.exists(f)) { message("Removing incomplete file: ", f); file.remove(f) }
    utils::download.file(q$url, f, mode = "wb", method = "libcurl")
  }
  if (!ok_gz(f)) stop("Download still incomplete: ", f,
                      "\nDownload it in your browser from ", q$url, " and save it as ", f)
  message(basename(f), ": ", round(file.size(f) / 1e6, 1), " MB")
  as.data.frame(data.table::fread(f))
}
expr_raw <- get_xena("TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap/HiSeqV2$")
clin_raw <- get_xena("TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap/BRCA_clinicalMatrix$")
stopifnot(nrow(expr_raw) > 15000, ncol(expr_raw) > 1000)   # ~20,530 genes x ~1,218 samples

expr <- as.matrix(expr_raw[, -1]); rownames(expr) <- toupper(trimws(expr_raw[[1]]))
storage.mode(expr) <- "numeric"
# Older HGNC symbols used in this matrix, renamed to current ones
ALIAS <- c(ORC6L = "ORC6", CDCA1 = "NUF2", KIAA0101 = "PCLAF")
hit <- names(ALIAS)[names(ALIAS) %in% rownames(expr) & !(ALIAS %in% rownames(expr))]
rownames(expr)[match(hit, rownames(expr))] <- ALIAS[hit]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(expr)))

need <- c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", PAM50_PROLIF_GENES)
miss <- setdiff(need, rownames(expr))
if (length(miss)) stop("Missing required genes: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r cohort}
# Primary tumours only (barcode type 01), one tumour per patient, PAM50 LumA or LumB
clin <- clin_raw %>%
  transmute(sample_id = sampleID, pam50 = PAM50Call_RNAseq) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% colnames(expr),
         substr(sample_id, 14, 15) == "01",
         pam50 %in% c("LumA", "LumB")) %>%
  mutate(patient = substr(sample_id, 1, 12)) %>%
  arrange(sample_id) %>% distinct(patient, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(luminal_subtype = factor(pam50, levels = c("LumA", "LumB")))

expr_log <- expr[, clin$sample_id]
ez <- make_gene_z(expr_log)
grp <- as.character(clin$luminal_subtype)
print(table(grp))
```

## 2. Covariates

```{r covariates}
filt <- tidyestimate::filter_common_genes(as.data.frame(expr_log), id = "hgnc_symbol",
                                          tidy = FALSE, tell_missing = FALSE, find_alias = TRUE)
est  <- tidyestimate::estimate_score(filt, is_affymetrix = FALSE)

ng  <- intersect(NONPAM50_PROLIF, rownames(ez))
cov <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(ez),
              mki67 = as.numeric(ez["MKI67", ]),
              prolif_module = colMeans(ez[PAM50_PROLIF_GENES, ], na.rm = TRUE),
              prolif_nonpam50 = colMeans(ez[ng, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(tibble(sample_id = est$sample, stromal = est$stromal,
                   immune = est$immune, estimate_score = est$estimate), by = "sample_id")
stopifnot(identical(cov$sample_id, clin$sample_id))
message("Non-PAM50 proliferation genes used: ", length(ng), " of ", length(NONPAM50_PROLIF))

covariate_res <- map_dfr(c("mki67", "prolif_module", "stromal", "immune", "estimate_score"),
  ~ group_test(cov[[.x]], grp) %>% mutate(feature = .x, .before = 1))
print(covariate_res)
```

## 3. Balance score at four adjustment levels

```{r adjustment-ladder}
fm <- rbind(ez[c("GCH1", "SLC40A1"), ], GCH1_minus_SLC40A1 = ez["GCH1", ] - ez["SLC40A1", ])

ladder <- imap_dfr(ADJ_LEVELS, function(vars, lvl) {
  map_dfr(FEATURES, function(f) {
    y <- as.numeric(fm[f, ])
    if (length(vars)) y <- residualize(y, cov[, vars, drop = FALSE])
    group_test(y, grp) %>% mutate(feature = f, .before = 1)
  }) %>% mutate(FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"), adjustment = lvl)
})
print(ladder)
```

## 4. Matched on proliferation, with the random-pair null

```{r matched}
run_match <- function(score_name) {
  pm <- cov[[score_name]]
  lo <- quantile(pm[grp == "LumB"], MATCH$trim_lo, na.rm = TRUE)
  hi <- quantile(pm[grp == "LumA"], MATCH$trim_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  sup <- which(is.finite(pm) & pm >= lo & pm <= hi)
  mi  <- sup[match_11(pm[sup], grp[sup], MATCH$caliper)]
  res <- map_dfr(FEATURES, ~ group_test(as.numeric(fm[.x, mi]), grp[mi]) %>%
                   mutate(feature = .x, .before = 1))
  list(mi = mi, res = res %>% mutate(matched_on = score_name),
       balance = tibble(matched_on = score_name,
                        n_pairs = sum(grp[mi] == "LumA"),
                        smd_all = smd(pm, grp), smd_matched = smd(pm[mi], grp[mi]),
                        balance_ok = abs(smd(pm[mi], grp[mi])) < 0.1))
}
runs <- map(c("prolif_module", "prolif_nonpam50", "mki67"), run_match)
matched_balance <- map_dfr(runs, "balance"); print(matched_balance)
matched_res     <- map_dfr(runs, "res");     print(matched_res)

# Controls in the primary matched set
mi  <- runs[[1]]$mi; isA <- grp[mi] == "LumA"
d1  <- function(y) fast_delta(y[isA], y[!isA])
set.seed(SPEC$seed)
pool  <- setdiff(rownames(ez), c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", PAM50_PROLIF_GENES))
pairs <- matrix(sample(pool, 2 * MATCH$n_null, replace = TRUE), ncol = 2)
nullc <- apply(pairs, 1, function(p) d1(as.numeric(ez[p[1], mi] - ez[p[2], mi])))
obs   <- matched_res$delta[matched_res$matched_on == "prolif_module" &
                           matched_res$feature == "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1"]
controls <- tibble(
  positive_control_prolif_module = d1(colMeans(ez[PAM50_PROLIF_GENES, mi])),
  null_pair_95th_abs = quantile(abs(nullc), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
  balance_delta_matched = obs,
  empirical_p = (1 + sum(abs(nullc) >= abs(obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (1 + sum(is.finite(nullc))))
print(controls)
```

## 5. Within-subtype correlation and verdict

```{r verdict}
pair_corr <- map_dfr(c("LumA", "LumB"), function(s) {
  ids <- grp == s
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(ez["GCH1", ids], ez["SLC40A1", ids], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  tibble(luminal_subtype = s, n = sum(ids), spearman_rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_value = ct$p.value)
})
print(pair_corr)

prim <- ladder %>% filter(adjustment == "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE", feature == "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1")
rule1 <- prim$delta > 0 && prim$FDR_BH < SPEC$fdr && prim$delta >= SPEC$min_delta
rule2 <- controls$balance_delta_matched > 0 &&
         abs(controls$balance_delta_matched) > controls$null_pair_95th_abs
writeLines(c(sprintf("Primary adjustment: delta = %.2f (%.2f to %.2f), FDR = %.2g -> %s",
                     prim$delta, prim$delta_lo, prim$delta_hi, prim$FDR_BH,
                     if (rule1) "REPLICATES" else "does not replicate"),
             sprintf("Matched: delta = %.2f, null 95th = %.2f, empirical P = %.3f -> %s",
                     controls$balance_delta_matched, controls$null_pair_95th_abs,
                     controls$empirical_p, if (rule2) "REPLICATES" else "does not replicate")))

out <- list(T_TCGA_covariates = covariate_res, T_TCGA_ladder = ladder,
            T_TCGA_matched_balance = matched_balance, T_TCGA_matched = matched_res,
            T_TCGA_matched_controls = controls, T_TCGA_pair_corr = pair_corr)
iwalk(out, ~ write_csv(.x, file.path(paths$tables, paste0(.y, ".csv"))))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(paths$tables, "session_info.txt"))
```
